Yesterday I am staying here, Property is good but room service is not satisfactory before check out I am ordered tea and mineral water after an hour no one is come to deliver. Then I am asking this to reception staff, he is looking to me as a goon... This is terrible 😔

I am requesting to higher officials please change these types of employees or do training how to deal with customer

Past experience is good with palm tree hotels but this one is not satisfactory

I had a disappointing experience at this hotel. They charged me ₹2200 for a bedsheet that had only a few simple stains, which could have easily been washed. This kind of overcharging feels unfair and unprofessional. Instead of understanding the situation, they were quick to place blame and demand money.

Such behavior from a hospitality business is not acceptable. A hotel should prioritize guest comfort and understanding—not just look for ways to make extra

My experience at Hot Green Palms, Delhi was nothing short of terrible. The staff, especially Krishna Dev, was extremely rude, aggressive, and disrespectful. He clearly lacks the professionalism expected in the hospitality industry. I was treated with arrogance and no courtesy at all.

To make matters worse, I was also charged an extra fee for card payment, which was never disclosed at the time of booking. This is unethical and unacceptable.

I booked through MakeMyTrip, expecting decent service, but instead got humiliated and overcharged. I am now seeking a full refund and have already filed a complaint.

Avoid this hotel if you value your money and peace of mind. Absolutely not recommended.
